\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=3,\qquad\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=1.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\oint_C(3 y + \sin{\left(x \right)})\,dx+(x + \cos{\left(y \right)})\,dy&=\iint_D(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y})\,dA\\&=\iint_D\left(1-\left(3\right)\right)\,dA\\&=\iint_D\left(-2\right)\,dA.\end{aligned}

$$
\Delta=\{(r,\theta):0\le r\le 6,\ 0\le\theta\le \frac{\pi}{2}\}.

$$
\iint_D f(x,y)\,dA=\iint_\Delta f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)\,r\,dr\,d\theta.
$$

$$
